calls.video_title: This Pullback is a Gift. I'm Buying These 3 Stocks NOW.
calls.price_at_call: ~$131B mkt cap; fwd P/E ~20 next yr; EPS growth 15-18%/yr (stated)
calls.thesis: Guest Matt McCall (Monument Traders Alliance) calls Eaton a core holding: power-grid/battery-backup supplier keeping hospitals, utilities and data centres running; pullback after AI-infrastructure run-up is a buying opportunity, PEG just above 1.
calls.base_case: Grid rebuild lasts 10+ years; AI data-centre demand layers on top of pre-AI grid upgrade need ($9.1T ASCE estimate).
calls.bull_case: Every AI player (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, neoclouds) needs Eaton's power-protection products.
calls.bear_case: Not a huge growth company; got pricey at the AI-infrastructure peak before the pullback.
